bullets.text: Designed a multi-agent NLP pipeline that converts raw reviews into structured JSON: review-type classification, sentiment analysis, supporting evidence quotes and staff-name linking, feeding client reporting dashboards that contributed to a 20% lift in client retention.

Cut inference costs with a two-tier routing architecture: urgent single reviews go to the Gemini API for low-latency responses, while large batch jobs run on a self-hosted production LLM Gemma 27B on company GPU hardware, keeping per-review costs down.

Raised subcategory recall from 0.78 to 0.96 (F1 0.98), evaluated on a 500-review golden set of hard cases, then locked in accuracy gains using an automated regression suite that re-runs evaluation on every change and fails the build if metrics drop.

Adopted by account managers preparing for client meetings: per-dealer sentiment analysis breakdowns show where a dealership is struggling before the team walks in, sharpening renewal and upsell conversations.
